title: Water Shoes – Quick-Drying for Streams & Beach
descriptionHtml:
Shoes you can wear both in and out of the water

Regular shoes get heavy and soaked at the stream and the beach. Barefoot it's easy to slip or hurt your foot on sharp stones.

Lightweight, non-slip and quick-drying

These water shoes dry quickly and have a non-slip sole that gives good grip on wet rocks. They're light and breathable so they feel comfortable all day.

Features

  • Quick-drying and breathable
  • Non-slip sole with good grip
  • Protects your foot from sharp stones
  • Easy to pack and carry
  • Great for streams, beach, kayaking and hiking

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
